preview_heading: Falcons meet Warriors in North Sound
preview: Antigua & Barbuda Falcons face Guyana Amazon Warriors in CPL 2026 Match 15 at Sir Vivian Richards Stadium. The match is scheduled for Sun 23 Aug at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: The Falcons bring Antiguan fast bowler Alzarri Joseph home for 2026 and add Evin Lewis to a returning core that includes Fabian Allen, Jayden Seales and Amir Jangoo. Guyana retain Shimron Hetmyer, Romario Shepherd, Shai Hope and Shamar Joseph, while 10 of their 12 locally selected players come from Guyana. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
